description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests related to WPS configuration, including enabling/disabling WPS, setting WPS methods, pairing clients via push buttons or PIN, and canceling sessions. It interacts with device configuration via specific setStr functions and manages user sessions.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum based on the Luhn algorithm pattern for 4 or 8 digit PINs.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to a specific SSID by setting appropriate device parameters.
